jobs.occupation: Forward Deployed Engineer: Ai Solution Architect (f/m/d) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description: As a Senior AI Solution Architect in our Forward Deployed Engineering team, you see the whole board before a single line of code is written. You partner directly with business leaders across Siemens to map complex challenges to existing data, design cross-platform architectures spanning cloud and enterprise systems, and make critical build-versus-buy decisions in days rather than quarters. You bridge deep technical AI expertise with systems thinking, acting as a force multiplier that enables agile engineering teams to deliver high-impact solutions reliably and repeatedly.What we offer you:- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interestsSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.You’ll make an impact by:- Driving rapid solution architecture as the first technical expert in every engagement, translating complex business problems into viable technical blueprints within days. - Designing interconnected solutions across the entire enterprise landscape, leveraging SDC for workloads while integrating seamlessly with SAP, Salesforce, and cloud-native services. - Owning crucial architecture decisions regarding cost, latency, scalability, and stack selection, while documenting clear justifications for every trade-off. - Evaluating emerging AI technologies with rigorous skepticism, providing evidence-backed adoption recommendations and having the courage to say "not ready yet." - Staying actively involved in the codebase through technical spikes, prototype development, and pull-request reviews to ensure your architectures remain grounded in reality. - Designing from day one for seamless handover, establishing explicit interface contracts, evaluation harnesses, and operational runbooks so domain teams can run systems autonomously.Your defining qualities:- Education: You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or a comparable quantitative field, where a proven track record of shipped systems outweighs advanced degrees. - Experience & Skills:- You bring 8 or more years of experience in software architecture, AI/ML systems design, or solution architecture, including at least 3 years focused on complex enterprise AI solutions. - You demonstrate a robust history of customer-facing delivery and technical leadership, especially when navigating demanding or high-pressure stakeholder environments. - You posses hands-on coding capabilities in Python alongside TypeScript or JavaScript, allowing you to write production-grade code and build functional prototypes. - You provide expertise in cross-platform system design by successfully integrating disparate enterprise environments like SAP, Salesforce, and modern cloud services. - You exhibit deep knowledge of the modern AI stack, covering LLM failure modes, RAG architectures, evaluation metrics, vector stores, and prominent agent frameworks. - You bring working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP) sufficient to design scalable multi-platform workloads.- Ways of working:- You demonstrate the critical ability to evaluate emerging technologies objectively, separate genuine value from hype, and communicate technical realities clearly. - You display exceptional live communication skills to sketch defensible architectures in real-time meetings and explain them fluently in business terms.- Languages: You have fluent English language skills, complemented by strong German proficiency as an advantageous asset for local stakeholder engagements.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usWe know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs.html) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/jobs/faq/) – if you need further information on the application process.

jobs.occupation: SAP Financial Compliance & Authorizations Deployment Specialist (m/f/d) - 2 years fixed term (Betriebswirt/in (Fachschule) - international)
jobs.description: At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.The PositionASPIRE is a multi-year program that will define, design, and deploy Future ERP solutions based on SAP S/4 HANA and other cloud/on-premise technology platforms. The program will enable simplified, standardized, and harmonized global business processes by capitalizing on SAP, Life Science Industry and Roche effective practices.The opportunity: * Preparation and leading of FIT-to-Template (assessment of the current business processes compared and aligned against the future Aspire Global Template) and scoping workshops for Financial Compliance* Liaising with local affiliate Finance stakeholders for the implementation of Financial Compliance requirements* Assessment of localization requirements for Authorization* Execution of Testing Activities during the deployment (UT, SAT, UAT, REG)* Go Live & Hyper care (incl. Month end closing) support* Ensure template governance within the project including change control management in line with the respective GBPMs/GBPOs and the overall Finance governance conceptWho you are* You have a university degree in Business Administration, Accounting or a related field.* 5+ years related business experience or equivalent Project Management skills in the area of SAP Authorization* Broad knowledge of business processes, policies and programs* Strong Project Management, business partner management, communication and change management skills. Experience in Agile Project Methodologies is a plus* Strong people skills are required as the role is highly consultative, interacting with staff at all levels across an organization * Proficiency in EnglishIn exchange we provide you with:* Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career. * Excellent benefits & flexibility:  competitive salary and cafeteria package, language allowance (if the position requires extra language), annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (2 office days/week on average).  We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.* A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.Duration: This position is temporary for 2 years.So far, so good?It gets even better. We offer you a wide range of top benefits at our sites. Only together with you can we improve patients' lives. Your contribution makes Roche unique. That’s why we provide extraordinary benefits that empower you to design your life, finances, and health just the way you want. Find out more here: https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DEYour ApplicationWe kindly ask you to submit the following documents:* Current resume (CV) or Workday profile* Your official (educational) certificates and transcriptsAdditional documents are currently not strictly required. Please note that no further documents can be added after submitting your application. jobs.occupation: Field Sales Engineer – Central EMEA (Technical-Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Role overviewAltera is seeking an experienced Field Sales Engineer to drive growth across an assigned territory in the Central EMEA region. Depending on the candidate’s background and the business need, the role may focus primarily on either:- Growing territory coverage, distribution customers, and channel-partner design wins; or- Developing a defined set of strategic customers through focused demand creation and account initiatives.The successful candidate will combine technical credibility, commercial drive, and strong relationship-building skills to turn customer and market opportunities into sustainable revenue growth.Job responsibilities- Develop and execute sales plans to achieve or exceed assigned revenue and design win targets.- Identify, qualify, and pursue new business opportunities, including early-stage demand creation and design-win activity.- Manage and grow customer accounts and, where applicable, distribution partners through strong multi-level relationships.- Own the broader commercial relationship with strategic customers and channel partners, including pricing, contractual terms, volume commitments, supply expectations, and issue escalation.- Understand customer needs and position Altera’s products and solutions effectively.- Prepare and deliver sales presentations, product demonstrations, technical proposals, and business cases.- Drive opportunities through the sales cycle, from prospecting and technical engagement through design win, negotiation, and closure.- Build joint business plans with channel partners or account plans with strategic customers, depending on the assigned focus.- Collaborate closely with field application engineering, applications engineering, marketing, product management, and product development.- Maintain accurate forecasts, pipeline data, opportunity plans, and customer information in the CRM system.- Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, and market conditions to identify opportunities and risks.- Represent Altera at customer meetings, industry events, trade shows, and partner activities.- Travel regularly within the assigned territory in Central EMEA.Qualifications- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.- At least five years of successful experience in technical sales, field applications, account management, or a comparable customer-facing role, preferably in semiconductors or embedded systems.- Demonstrated success in meeting or exceeding sales targets.- Strong understanding of FPGAs, SoCs, and related hardware and software design flows is highly preferred.- Experience with distribution partners, channel ecosystems, strategic accounts, or technology-driven customer programs.- Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.- Strong customer-development, opportunity-management, forecasting, and CRM skills.- Self-motivated, proactive, commercially minded, and results-oriented.- Proficiency with CRM systems such as Salesforce and Microsoft Office or comparable tools.- Fluency in German and English, both written and spoken, is required.Willingness to travel frequently within the assigned territory in Central EMEA.Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: Verhandlungsführung, Kundenberatung, -betreuung, Präsentation, Pre-Sales-Service

In the role of RDT Business Partner at Roche Digital Technology (RDT) / Informatics, you will make a decisive contribution to turning our vision "Doing now what patients need next" into reality. Here, we combine technological innovation with commercial goals to continuously improve patient care through digital solutions and actively shape the healthcare ecosystem.Responsibilities | What awaits youIn this role, you will take responsibility for the strategic connection between Roche Digital Technology (RDT) and the assigned business functions to advance Roche's strategic goals through groundbreaking technology solutions. In addition, you will take on the following exciting tasks:* Stakeholder Management: You act as a trusted strategic partner and advisor to business leaders, co-create technology-enabled strategies, and proactively drive global process improvements.* Bridge between Local & Global: You bundle the local requirements of the business functions (Commercial, Finance, P&C, Supply Chain, etc.), advocate for local needs at the global level when necessary, and conversely bring global standard solutions effectively to Germany.* Innovation & Impact: You specifically identify business opportunities and work closely with Product Leads to design, prototype, and continuously develop innovative technological capabilities.* Complexity Management: You are accountable for the successful delivery of technology-enabled business outcomes (such as annual revenue goals or patient access) for commercial areas.* Problem Solving: In strong partnership with Product Engineering Teams, you are responsible for the escalation and targeted resolution of complex, systemic challenges.* Technology Focus: As a Key Opinion Leader, you drive the technological vision forward, manage stakeholders end-to-end, and scale pilot solutions to maximize their added value.Qualifications | Who you areFor this demanding interface role, you bring sound IT knowledge, strong business acumen, and excellent communication skills:* Education: Successfully completed Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field; a Master’s degree or MBA is a plus.* Professional Experience & Industry Knowledge: Sound experience participating in IT projects within complex matrix organizations as well as strong business acumen in the pharmaceutical / life sciences environment.* Partnership & Moderation: Proven track record of building trusted relationships across different organizational levels (including management level), as well as strong competence in conflict management and moderating complex interfaces.* Language & Communication Skills: You bring excellent communication skills (fluent/negotiating-level English for collaboration in a global environment as well as very good German skills for daily interaction at the Grenzach site).* Working Style & Presence: High flexibility, strong analytical skills, and systems thinking, as well as the willingness for on-site presence at the Grenzach location.* Teamwork: Strong ability to collaborate constructively in cross-functional, agile teams and to actively promote appreciative cooperation.Duration: This position is a temporary assignment limited until January 2028.Your ApplicationWe ask you for a current CV and your official (educational) certificates/proofs. Your contact to us! With people. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.Let’s build a healthier future, together.Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.occupation: Specialist People Systems Implementation Management (f/m/d) (IT-Service-Delivery-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Join the exciting part of our People Services & AI department!People Services & AI supports employees and managers in more than 50 countries from three hubs.The Systems Configuration Team ensures that our global HRIS landscape — across both Workday and ServiceNow — evolves in a structured, scalable, and user‑focused way.This role focuses on expert Workday and ServiceNow configuration and support, release enablement, and functional guidance across our active licenses. It touches any area where configuration, module ownership, requirement clarification, or stakeholder alignment is needed.Responsibilities / Tasks* Take ownership for selected Workday and ServiceNow areas and act as the key contact for configuration, improvements, and further development.* Analyse requirements, assess change requests, and translate business needs into scalable and sustainable system configurations.* Configure Workday modules and support ServiceNow configuration changes, including structured documentation.* Analyze Workday releases, assess impacts, validate new features, and drive the adoption of relevant changes.* Manage & implement cross-module configurations and broader system updates across Workday and ServiceNow.* Support project-driven configuration activities, testing, cutover validation, and readiness activities while ensuring alignment with architectural and design principles.* Collaborate closely with Product Owners, People Services, IT teams, and internal/external partners to drive harmonization and standardization across regions and teams.Your Profile / Qualifications* Several years of hands‑on Workday configuration experience in an international environment.* Experience with reporting, cross‑module logic, or complex business process configuration in Workday.* Experience in digital process design, including translating business needs into scalable, automated workflows.* Broad functional understanding across multiple Workday modules.* Experience analyzing releases, validating impacts, and supporting feature adoption.* Familiarity with ServiceNow HRSD module and configuration or willingness to learn.* Strong skills in requirement refinement, stakeholder alignment, and solution design.* Analytical, structured, and solution‑oriented working style.* Confident and clear communicator across stakeholder levels.* Fluent in English.Preferred* Experience with Atlassian products (Jira, Confluence).* SQL knowledge or willingness to learn.* German language skills.* Degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, HR, Computer Science, or a related field.What Happens After You Apply?You will receive an email once your application has been processed.A Talent Acquisition Specialist will review your profile and verify that you meet the qualification criteria.If successful, you will be invited to the first interview (virtual or in person).Typically, a final decision is made after two or three interview rounds.*For reasons of readability, no gender‑specific differentiation is made in the job advertisement. The role is explicitly open to all persons.Did we spark your interest?Then please click apply above to access our guided application process.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Workday-Modul HR/HCM, SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS)Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Content Collaboration-Software Confluence, Fehlerverwaltungsprogramm Jira

jobs.occupation: PhD position (m/f/d) on immune reset through CAR T in chronic inflammatory diseases (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description: State-of-the-art medicine and nursing care you can rely on! - Since being founded in 1815, Universitätsklinikum Erlangen has offered medicine of the highest standard and incorporated the latest insights from medical research and state-of-the-art equipment into diagnosis and therapy. More than 10.000 employees from approximately 50 different occupations are needed to provide the wide range of services offered by Universitätsklinikum Erlangen, ensuring our patients receive the very best care around the clock.As a PhD student, you will investigate how human immune-cell networks shape tissue inflammation, regeneration and response to cellular therapies. The project will focus primarily on the human immune system and combine patient-derived material with experimental models to address mechanistic questions in cellular immunology.Your tasks:- Characterizing human immune-cell populations and their functional states using multiparameter flow cytometry and high-dimensional immune phenotyping.- Investigating cellular interactions and immune networks by integrating phenotypic, functional and molecular data from immune cells and tissues.- Studying immune responses to cellular therapies, including the mechanisms underlying immune depletion, reconstitution and tissue regeneration following CD19 CAR-T-cell therapy.- Generating and analyzing molecular data using approaches such as bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing and other transcriptomic or spatial technologies.- Establishing and applying experimental models to investigate mechanisms identified in human samples, including selected mouse models of intestinal inflammation, immune reconstitution and tissue regeneration after CD19 CAR-T-cell therapy.- Developing and combining experimental and analytical approaches ranging from established methods such as ELISA, Western blotting and flow cytometry to advanced multidimensional cytometry, UMAP-based analysis and transcriptomic approaches.- The project offers substantial scope to develop an individual scientific profile. Previous experience with these techniques is welcome, but curiosity, scientific independence, willingness to learn, and enthusiasm for understanding how immune cells interact in human disease are similarly important.Essential experience/ qualifications:- Above the average motivation and work ethics- Strong theoretical and practical background in standard methods of molecular and cellular biology as well as cellular immunology- English writing and speaking skills- Ability to work together in a multi-national team that is supportive of one another- A master degree (M.Sc.) in immunology, biology, molecular biology, molecular medicine or equivalentadditional advantages:- Experience in omics data science- Hands-on experience in human immunologyWe offer:- The position is full-time and will be payed according to salary group TVL-E 13, 65% (DFG-typical rate)- Intended pay grade depending on qualifications and personal requierements- Initially, the position is limited for one year, with the possibility of an extension till the degreee is achieved- The head of the department guaranties in writing that there is funding till the degree is achieved.- Hiring process opened and will be completed asap.- An enthusiastic, interdisciplinary team of scientists and doctors- High end translational research- State-of-the-art laboratories- Two-Stepp mentoring with a hands-on mentor (post-doc) plus the PI as supervisor with high frequent project discussions for efficient development- Structured program for hard- and soft-skills in research (paper and grant writing classes, paper clubs, soft-skill training)- Notes for applicants (f/m/d) ( https://www.karriere.uk-erlangen.de/bewerbung/hinweise-fuer-bewerbende/ )- Comprehensive health promotion offers- All benefits of the public service incl. supplementary pension plan of the Versorgungsanstalt des Bundes und der Länder (VBL) (Federal and State Government Employees' Retierment Fund)- Family-friendly enviromentFurther information:Prof. Dr. med. habil. Fabian MüllerMedizinische Klinik 5Phone: 09131 - 85 43107Applications:Universitätsklinikum ErlangenMedizinische Klinik 5 -Hämatologie & Internistische OnkologiePD Dr. med. habil. Fabian MüllerUlmenweg 1891054 Erlangen
